## M09 implementation progress under ruling 5978927926

The bounded existing-owner repair is implemented locally. This is WIP proof,
not the final PR audit or closure of the complete 48-row class. Audit-only HEAD
remains baadec1e4 plus uncommitted implementation; no production push was made.

- Each Docker launch binds an immutable container and an ephemeral invocation
  coordinate. The native identity/ready frame requires an exact launch
  acknowledgement before execution. Open stdin carries the attachment lifetime;
  loss cancels joined interpreter/HTTP work. The inherited Linux input is
  poller-owned so normal completion can also join its blocking observer.
- Read-only process observation must prove the exact worker gone separately
  from client exit. Docker's required PID column is not retained or used as
  authority. A failed/unacknowledged observation remains cleanup-unproven and
  uncertain, preserving the original client and independent cleanup errors.
- Host and Docker lost-response errors cannot authorize a possibly committed
  tool retry. Mock settlement consumes the same facts; logical cancellation and
  deadlines survive the closed native result instead of becoming internal errors.
- No ledger, supervisor, container-wide retirement, replay, compatibility
  path or third-party dependency was added. All model/probe/tool consumers
  retain the same worker owner.
